notes.title: Improved Endless Mode and Slovak Localistion introduction
notes.content:
As per the previous post this is just very quick update that brings everything the latest experimental version introduced into live 1.1 version while also adding partial Slovak Localization (whole UI and most of the game is now localized into Slovak as well - only the story is left to be translated).

If you happen to stumble upon any bugs, typos or issues with localization feel free to reach out to me via Discord and I am always happy to improve any of my games.

[b]There is full list of changes in the new version:[/b]

   [list]
[*]  Main Menu UI tweaked to accommodate for bug that caused gold value to disappear
[*]     Buildings texts changed to better reflect what which building is doing
[*]     Buildings tweaked to provide scalable bonuses
[*]     Prompt for Sentry Towers being miss leading fixed
[*]     The game can now run on background when minimized
[*]     All weapons has been balanced
[*]     Some legacy stats on weapons has been removed as they were no longer used
[*]     Endless / survival mode now has procedural difficulty past round 50
[*]     Merchant mode now has procedural difficulty past round 65
[*]     Tavern story font changed to something more readable
[*]     Tavern mode and features bound not only to active level but also overall progression now
[/list]

notes.title: ENDLESS QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I just pushed new experimental version of Gems Defenders and made it available for everyone. This means that you can download and experience it for yourself right now without being scared for me messing up your game with new features (I am working all alone so it's easy to have some bugs slip by :) ).

Most of these are based on requests and feedback from community.

[b]There is full list of changes in the new version:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Menu UI tweaked to accommodate for bug that caused gold value to disappear
[*] Buildings texts changed to better reflect what which building is doing
[*] Buildings tweaked to provide scalable bonuses
[*] Prompt for Sentry Towers being miss leading fixed
[*] The game can now run on background when minimized
[*] All weapons has been balanced
[*] Some legacy stats on weapons has been removed as they were no longer used
[*] Endless / survival mode now has procedural difficulty past round 50 
[*] Merchant mode now has procedural difficulty past round 65
[*] Tavern story font changed to something more readable
[*] Tavern mode and features bound not only to active level but also overall progression now
[/list]

Once I am happy with the feedback and how the game runs I will push this into production and begin work on further updates and tweaks.

notes.title: First bigger update
notes.content:
Hey yo! First bigger update is here and it fixes the following:
[list]
[*] Fixes bug that caused News window to pop up way too often.
[*] Leaving Survival, Merchant or Story levels early to not award player with experience and gold.
[*] A lot of typos and grammar mistakes have been fixed in both Czech and English language.
[/list]

It also brought the following community requested changes and Quality of Life improvements:
[list]
[*] Removed blocking property of cracked gems.
[*] Points to obtain gold coin has been decreased from 25 to 10.
[*] Cooldown length and mana cost is now part of talent description for all spells.
[/list]

As part of feedback from various people I received a lot of complains about the game being little bit too difficult and punishing. As a way to aid that I decided to remove the blocking property of cracked gems completely so these are now purely aesthetic. Also a lot of people complained about not being able to afford town upgrades or talent resets even after playing through half of the story campaign. For that reasons I decided to make it way easier to acquire gold by decreasing the point threshold to 10 points from previous 25. These two changes should make the game noticeably easier while also keeping the intended difficulty of fights as is. But because I do understand that different people like different difficulties I am planning on introducing difficulty slider in some of the future updates.

And lastly as the sub title says - I would love to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who has been so generous to buy Gems Defenders and support my work!

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.content:
Thanks to awesome feedback of community members (namely Paj & Gara) I was made aware of two game breaking bugs that did not happened before while playtesting the game prior to the release. This update should squish these bugs. There is bug fixes more to follow in future bigger update as this was just quick hotfix.

Should you find an bug please report it to me and I will fix it as soon as possible.
